Alt text only writes the alt text of an inline data image

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
use HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions;
$options = \HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions::from_json(json_encode(["inlineDataMedia" => "AltTextOnly"]));
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<p>Before <img src=\"data:image/png;base64,AAAA\" alt=\"icon\"> after</p>", $options);
var_dump($result->content);
```
